tool.name: FatslimMembranes
tool.description: : Wrapper of the FATSLiM membranes module for leaflet and membrane identification.

param.name: input_top_path
param.label: input TPR,GRO,G96,PDB,BRK,ENT file
param.help: Path to the input topology file. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: input_traj_path
param.label: input XTC,TRR,CPT,GRO,G96,PDB,TNG file
param.help: Path to the GROMACS trajectory file. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: input_ndx_path
param.label: input NDX file
param.help: Path to the input lipid headgroups index NDX file. Format: [input].ndx

param.name: outname_output_ndx_path
param.label: output NDX name
param.help: Path to the output index NDX file Format: [output].ndx

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: selection
param.label: selection
param.help: Alternative ot the NDX file for choosing the Headgroups used in the identification using MDAnalysis selection language.

param.name: cutoff
param.label: cutoff
param.help: Cutoff distance (in nm) to be used when leaflet identification is performed.

param.name: begin_frame
param.label: begin_frame
param.help: First frame index to be used for analysis.

param.name: end_frame
param.label: end_frame
param.help: Last frame index to be used for analysis.

param.name: ignore_no_box
param.label: ignore_no_box
param.help: Ignore the absence of box information in the topology. If the topology does not contain box information, the box will be set to the minimum and maximum positions of the atoms.

param.name: return_hydrogen
param.label: return_hydrogen
param.help: Include hydrogen atoms in the output index file.

param.name: binary_path
param.label: binary_path
param.help: Path to the fatslim executable binary.
